situation: Need my ex Mark to split our daughter Ava's braces. Dr Patel quoted $4,800: $1,200 deposit due Nov 1, then $200 a month for 18 months. Our agreement splits medical costs 50/50, but he usually argues about money.
reply: Hi Mark, Dr Patel has recommended braces for Ava. The total is $4,800: a $1,200 deposit due 1 November, then $200 a month for 18 months. Quote attached. As per our agreement on medical costs, could you send your half of the deposit, $600, by 30 October? Please let me know by Friday. Thanks.
note: Every number is in writing with the quote attached, which leaves little to argue about.

situation: My ex sent a long angry text about me 'turning the kids against her', and at the very end asked if I'm still dropping Noah and Ella off at hers Sunday at 5.
reply: Yes, I'll drop Noah and Ella at yours on Sunday at 5 as planned.
note: Answer the logistics, ignore the rest. If the accusations continue, keep a record and raise it through mediation, not by text.

situation: 离婚两年，孩子朵朵平时跟前妻住，我隔周周末接她。10月17、18日那个周末我要出差，想和前妻换到24、25日。
reply: 你好，10月17、18日那个周末我要出差，想和你换一下：我改接24、25日，17、18日朵朵留在你那边。可以的话周三前回我一下，谢谢。
note: 一条消息只谈一件事，给出具体日期和回复期限，不提以往。

situation: My ex Jenna and I keep ending up in 40-message text fights that start with a pickup time and end with stuff from 2019. I've set up an account on a co-parenting app and want to propose moving all scheduling there from Monday Oct 5. The kids are Liam (9) and Rosie (6).
reply: Hi Jenna, to keep things simpler for both of us, could we move all scheduling and costs for Liam and Rosie to a co-parenting app from Monday 5 October? Then we both see the same calendar and receipts in one place, and texts can stay for anything urgent on the day. I've set up an account and can send you an invite tonight. Can you let me know by Friday if that works?
note: Frame the app as simpler for both, with no mention of the fights; one line about 2019 would start the next one.

situation: I've been seeing Dan for about a year and want him to meet our son Leo (7) briefly, about an hour at the park on Saturday Oct 17. My ex Chris and I get on okay-ish. I want him to hear it from me first.
reply: Hi Chris, I wanted you to hear this from me first. I've been seeing someone, Dan, for about a year, and I'm planning for him to meet Leo briefly at the park on Saturday 17 October, about an hour, nothing framed as a big deal. If you have any concerns, can you let me know by Sunday 11 October so we can talk before then? Thanks.
note: Informing, not asking permission: give the date and a window to raise concerns, and keep it free of relationship detail.

situation: Pedi para o meu ex, Rafael, trocar o fim de semana de 17 e 18 de outubro por causa do aniversário da minha mãe. Ele disse que não e que eu 'sempre mudo tudo em cima da hora'. O fim de semana seguinte, 24 e 25, é meu. Nossos filhos são a Clara (8) e o Theo (5).
reply: Oi Rafael, entendido, o fim de semana de 17 e 18 de outubro fica como está. Vamos comemorar o aniversário da minha mãe no sábado 24, quando a Clara e o Theo estiverem comigo. Obrigada.
note: Ignore o 'sempre', aceite o não em uma linha e se organize em volta dele. Uma recusa não é um padrão.

situation: Our daughter Maya (10) lives with me during the week. Her teacher, Ms. Reyes, emailed that Maya has missed 6 homework assignments since school started and wants a parent conference Thursday Oct 8 at 4:15. I want my ex, Daniel, to come too, without it sounding like I'm blaming his weekends.
reply: Hi Daniel, Maya's teacher, Ms. Reyes, has asked for a parent conference on Thursday Oct 8 at 4:15 at school. She says Maya has missed 6 homework assignments since term started and I'd like us both to be there so we hear the same thing. Can you let me know by Friday whether you can make it? Thanks.
note: School concerns go to the co-parent as facts plus one yes-or-no question. No guessing in writing about whose days the homework slipped on.

situation: 和前夫离婚一年，儿子乐乐7岁，这周跟我住。今天周三下午他发烧38.5度，带去看了医生，说是病毒性感冒，要吃三天药。周五晚上6点轮到他爸接。想给前夫发条消息说一下。
reply: 你好，说一下乐乐的情况。他今天下午发烧到38.5度，带他看了医生，说是病毒性感冒，开了三天的药，吃到周五。周五交接时药和医嘱我放在他书包里。如果周五他还在发烧，你是按原计划6点接，还是改到周六上午？周四晚上前告诉我就行。谢谢。
note: 医疗情况只写事实：诊断、用药、交接安排，再加一个带期限的问题；不评价对方，不提过去。

situation: I want to take our kids Sofia (9) and Mateo (6) to see my parents in Guadalajara during my Christmas weeks, Dec 20 to Jan 2. The airline needs a signed consent letter from my ex, Ryan, and I've drafted one. We're civil, but he gets anxious about the kids travelling abroad.
reply: Hi Ryan, I'd like to take Sofia and Mateo to my parents' in Guadalajara during my holiday weeks, flying out Sunday 20 December and back Saturday 2 January. I'll send you the flight numbers and my parents' address and phone, and the kids can video call you on Christmas Day and any other day you'd like. Because they're travelling abroad, the airline needs a signed consent letter from you; I've attached a draft. Can you let me know by Friday 16 October if you're okay to sign it? Thanks.
note: Answer the anxious parent's questions with facts before he asks (flights, address, calls), not reassurance, and give weeks rather than days to reply.

situation: 离婚后女儿朵朵平时跟我住，隔周周末去她爸那里，按约定课外班费用一人一半。朵朵想报区体育中心的游泳班，每周六上午9点到10点，10月10日开课，12节课1,440元，10月6日报名截止。有一半的周六轮到她爸带，需要他送。
reply: 你好，朵朵想报游泳班：每周六上午9点到10点，在区体育中心，10月10日开课，一共12节，1,440元。按我们的约定学费一人一半，你这边是720元。轮到你带她的那几个周六，需要你送她过去。报名10月6日截止，麻烦10月5日前告诉我这样可不可以。谢谢。
note: 一条消息只谈一件事：时间、地点、金额和需要他做的事写清楚，再给一个能回答“行”或“不行”的问题和期限。

situation: My ex Tom has been 40 to 70 minutes late for the last three Friday pickups (Sept 11, 18 and 25). Pickup is supposed to be 5:30. Our son Ben is 8 and waits by the window with his bag.
reply: Hi Tom, the last three Friday pickups were between 6:10 and 6:40 instead of 5:30. Ben waits by the window with his bag, so not knowing the time is hard on him. Can we either stick to 5:30 or move pickup to 6:30, starting this Friday, Oct 2? Either works for me as long as it's consistent. Can you let me know by Thursday? Thanks.
note: Times and dates instead of 'always'; offering a later fixed time makes the fix easy to say yes to, and the message reads fine on the record.

situation: Our daughter Zara turns 12 on Nov 14, and my ex Omar and I agreed she'll get her first phone for her birthday. She splits the week between our homes. I want us to agree the same basic rules at both houses before she gets it.
reply: Hi Omar, about Zara's phone for her birthday on 14 November. I'd like us to use the same basic rules at both houses so she isn't switching between two systems. My proposal: the phone charges outside her bedroom from 9pm, no social media accounts until we both agree, and we both know her passcode. Does that work for you, or is there anything you'd change? It'd be good to settle it by 31 October so we can tell her together. Thanks.
note: Agreeing rules before the phone arrives is one topic with a deadline; the details can move, the consistency is the point.

situation: 离婚协议写的是前夫每月5号前转2,000元抚养费给女儿小雨。9月的到今天还没收到，他之前从来没拖过。想发微信提醒一下，不想吵。
reply: 你好，9月份小雨的抚养费2,000元我这边还没收到，按约定是每月5号前。可能是转账漏了，麻烦你这周五10月2日前转一下，转好跟我说一声就行。谢谢。
note: 第一次没按时付：只讲金额、约定和期限，不猜原因、不威胁；如果之后反复拖欠，保留记录，通过调解或律师处理，而不是在微信上升级。

situation: My ex Priya texted that her boyfriend Kevin will start picking up our son Arjun (7) from school on Tuesdays and Thursdays from next week. I've never met Kevin. I'm not against it, I just want to meet him before he starts.
reply: Hi Priya, thanks for letting me know about Kevin doing the Tuesday and Thursday pickups. I'd like to meet him briefly before he starts, so Arjun sees us say hello and I know who's collecting him. Could we do ten minutes at the school gate on Monday 5 October at 3:15, or another time before Tuesday that suits you? Thanks.
note: On the receiving end of new-partner news: no comment on the relationship, one reasonable request tied to the child, with a date. Check separately that the school has him on the pickup list.

situation: 离婚协议里没写春节孩子跟谁过。去年春节儿子豆豆在我这，今年前夫说想带他回老家过年。我想干脆定个规矩，以后按年轮流。
reply: 你好，说一下春节的安排。协议里没写，我想定个固定办法：明年（2027年）春节从除夕到初三，豆豆跟你回老家，2028年跟我，之后每年轮流。具体接送时间你定，提前一周告诉我就行。同意的话，我们各自回一句“同意”留个记录，以后就不用每年再商量。麻烦10月15日前回我。谢谢。
note: 把一次性的安排变成固定规则，一条消息只谈这一件事，写成书面、有期限的是非题。

situation: 离婚后女儿小满（9岁）隔周周末跟她爸住。他最近在抖音上发了好几条小满的视频，9月26日那条能看到她穿着校服，还拍到了校门口的校名。我不想吵，只想让他删掉那条，以后别拍到学校信息。
reply: 你好，说一下小满视频的事。抖音上9月26日那条，能看到她的校服和校门口的校名，麻烦10月2日周五前删掉。以后我们俩发她的照片和视频，都不拍校服、学校和小区名字，这条我这边也一样遵守。同意的话回我一句“好”就行。谢谢。
note: Make the rule apply to both parents, so it reads as protecting the child, not policing him.

situation: I'm moving from Eastgate to Riverside on Nov 21, about 25 minutes further from my ex Dana's place. Our kids, Noah (11) and Lily (8), switch homes at Sunday 6pm handovers, currently at my place. Millfield library is roughly halfway and I'd like to propose meeting there.
reply: Hi Dana, a heads up on a change: I'm moving from Eastgate to Riverside on 21 November, which is about 25 minutes further from you. For the Sunday 6pm handovers, would you be okay with meeting halfway, at Millfield library, so neither of us does the whole drive? Could you let me know by Friday 30 October so I can plan? Thanks.
note: One topic, the fact that changes, a proposal that shares the cost, and a date for the answer.

situation: My son Jonah (10) switches between my place and my ex Claire's every week. Twice this month his asthma inhaler stayed at one house, and on Monday he had to use the school nurse's spare. I want to suggest each house keeps its own inhaler; his GP can prescribe a second one.
reply: Hi Claire, one thing about Jonah's inhaler. It's stayed behind at one house twice this month, and on Monday he had to use the school nurse's spare. I'd like each of us to keep one at home so it doesn't depend on the bag, and his GP can prescribe a second. I can book the appointment this week if you're okay with it; could you let me know by Friday?
note: Health logistics without blame: 'stayed at one house', not 'you forgot'. If he ever struggles to breathe, call emergency services first.

situation: Our son Eli (14) told me he'd like to sleep at his dad Marcus's on Friday nights during football season, because his 9am Saturday matches are at Oakfield Park, five minutes from Marcus. Fridays are currently mine. The season runs Oct 10 to March 20, and I'm fine with it if I get Sunday afternoons, 1 to 6, instead.
reply: Hi Marcus, Eli has asked if he can stay at yours on Friday nights during football season, since his 9am Saturday matches are at Oakfield Park, close to you. I'm happy with that if I have him on Sunday afternoons from 1 to 6 instead. The season runs 10 October to 20 March. Could you let me know by Monday if that works for you? Thanks.
note: The child's wish is passed on as a plain fact by the parent, not by the child, with the trade already proposed.

situation: On Saturday, my weekend, our daughter Nora (6) fell off the monkey bars. Urgent care found a hairline fracture in her left wrist and put her in a cast for four weeks. The follow-up at the fracture clinic is Wednesday Oct 7 at 3:30, which is my ex Tom's day, and I can take her if he can't.
reply: Hi Tom, Nora fell off the monkey bars on Saturday and urgent care found a hairline fracture in her left wrist. She's in a cast for four weeks. Her follow-up at the fracture clinic is Wednesday 7 October at 3:30, which is your day. Would you like to take her, or shall I? Please let me know by Monday. Thanks.
note: Medical facts, the date and one question; no account of who was watching. If a child is badly hurt, call emergency services first and message after.

situation: Mi ex, Javier, me escribe que lo han despedido y me pide pagar la mitad de la pensión de nuestra hija Lucía (8 años), 150 € en vez de 300 €, en octubre, noviembre y diciembre. Estoy dispuesta a aceptarlo por esos tres meses si queda por escrito y en enero vuelve a los 300 €.
reply: Hola Javier, siento lo del trabajo. Te propongo esto: en octubre, noviembre y diciembre la pensión de Lucía será de 150 € al mes, y a partir de enero vuelve a ser de 300 €. ¿Me confirmas por aquí que estás de acuerdo con esos meses y esos importes? Gracias.
note: Un cambio de dinero temporal se deja por escrito con fecha de inicio y de fin. Si hiciera falta cambiar el convenio, consúltalo con un abogado o mediador.

situation: Tonight at the 6pm handover for his midweek overnight, my ex Sam arrived smelling strongly of alcohol and planning to drive our kids, Ruby (7) and Finn (4), to his place. I kept them home and he left angry. I want to text him now: I'm happy for him to have them tomorrow, Thursday, from after school until 7pm if he's sober.
reply: Sam, I kept Ruby and Finn home tonight because you smelled strongly of alcohol at the 6pm handover and you were going to drive them. I won't put them in a car in that situation. You're welcome to have them tomorrow, Thursday, from after school until 7pm, sober. Can you confirm by noon tomorrow? Thanks.
note: If someone is about to drive drunk with children, call emergency services first. Keep this message factual; for a repeat, check your custody order and talk to a family lawyer.

situation: Our son Kai (11) wants to go on his school's residential trip to an outdoor centre, 4 to 6 November. It's £180, our agreement splits school trips 50/50, and the school needs the consent form and a £50 deposit by Friday 9 October. I messaged my ex Jamie about it on 24 September and haven't had a reply; I'm happy for Kai to go and can sign the form myself.
reply: Hi Jamie, following up on my message of 24 September about Kai's residential trip to the outdoor centre, 4 to 6 November. It's £180, so £90 each under our agreement on school trips, and the school needs the consent form and a £50 deposit by Friday 9 October. Could you let me know by Wednesday 7 October if you're okay with him going? If I haven't heard by then, I'll pay the deposit so he keeps his place, and we can settle the split afterwards. Thanks.
note: When a co-parent goes quiet, one follow-up with a date and a sensible default protects the child's place without pretending they agreed.

situation: 离婚两年，儿子浩浩14岁，平时跟我住，隔周周末去他爸家。10月10、11日这个周末轮到他爸，浩浩跟我说想在家复习，因为10月12日周一期中考试，但他不太敢跟爸爸开口。我不想当传话筒，想让他们父子俩自己商量。
reply: 你好，说一下10月10、11日这个周末。浩浩10月12日周一期中考试，他跟我说想在家复习，但不太好意思跟你开口。我跟他说这事最好他自己跟你商量，所以麻烦你10月8日周四前给他打个电话，你们俩定。不管最后在哪边过，我这边都配合。谢谢。
note: State the fact once and hand the conversation back to father and son, so the child is never the messenger.

situation: Our son Max (10) has asked both me and my ex, Laura, for a games console for Christmas, about £280. Last year we both bought him the same scooter. I'd like to suggest we split the console 50/50 as a joint present and each do smaller gifts separately; I'm happy to order it, and I need to know by Sunday 1 November.
reply: Hi Laura, Max has asked us both for a games console for Christmas, about £280. Would you like to make it a joint present from both of us, £140 each, and we each do smaller gifts separately? I'm happy to order it and send you the receipt. Could you let me know by Sunday 1 November? Thanks.
note: Leave last year's double scooter out of it; the proposal alone prevents a repeat without sounding like a complaint.

situation: My daughter Ella (9) came back from her mum Kate's on Sunday and told me 'Mum says you have to pay half of my £40 ballet costume by Friday.' Our agreement splits activity costs 50/50 and I'm happy to pay; I just want Kate to send me anything about costs directly instead of through Ella.
reply: Hi Kate, Ella mentioned the £40 ballet costume. Happy to pay my half, £20: could you send me the receipt or the school's note, and I'll transfer it by Friday? Going forward, could anything about costs or plans come straight to me by message, so Ella doesn't have to carry it? Thanks.
note: Pay the cost without fuss, then ask once for the direct channel, framed around Ella and with no comment on what was said to her.

situation: On Tuesday my train was cancelled and my ex Paul picked up our twins, Eva and Jude (7), from after-school club at 6 on my day, with an hour's notice. Things between us are tense and we mostly stick to logistics. I want to thank him, and I'm happy to have the kids on Saturday 17 October, his weekend, if he'd like a free day.
reply: Hi Paul, thanks for picking up Eva and Jude from after-school club on Tuesday at such short notice, it made a real difference. If it's useful, I'm happy to have them on Saturday 17 October so you get a free day. Could you let me know by Wednesday 14 October either way? Thanks.
note: Thanks in a tense co-parenting relationship stays brief and specific, and the offer is an easy yes or no, not a debt he has to repay.

situation: 我叫林悦，是朵朵（8岁）爸爸的现任妻子。朵朵爸爸和前妻周敏每周五下午5点在学校门口交接。下周五10月9日他出差，他已经跟周敏说好那天由我去接，周敏回了“好”。这是我第一次直接联系周敏，想发微信说一下，不想越界。
reply: 周敏你好，我是林悦。下周五10月9日朵朵爸爸出差，之前他跟你说过那天由我去接朵朵，下午5点在学校门口，我会提前十分钟到。朵朵有没有什么需要我特别注意的，比如要带的东西？周四晚上前告诉我就好，谢谢。
note: 继任伴侣第一次联系对方：说清自己是谁，只谈这一次接送，不评论任何人，育儿上的决定留给两位父母。

situation: My ex, Rob, texted asking if I'm okay with him getting our daughter Isla (7) her ears pierced on his weekend, Saturday 10 October, as an early birthday present. I'd rather wait until she's 10 and can look after the piercings herself. We've always made decisions like this together.
reply: Hi Rob, thanks for checking with me first. I'd rather we waited on Isla's ears until she's 10, when she can look after the piercings herself, and then raised it with her together. If you see it differently, could you let me know by Thursday 8 October so we can settle it before Saturday? Thanks.
note: A non-urgent decision you disagree on: thank them for asking, give your view with one reason, and keep it joint; if you still can't agree, mediation is the next step, not a longer text.

situation: My ex Jordan collects our daughter Mia (6) from my front door at 6pm on Sundays for his weekends, and the last two handovers turned into arguments in front of her. I'd like his weekends to run from Friday school pickup at 3:15 to Monday school drop-off instead, so handovers happen at school; his next weekend is 9 to 11 October.
reply: Hi Jordan, I'd like to propose a change to handovers. Starting with your next weekend, could you collect Mia from school on Friday 9 October at 3:15 and drop her at school on Monday 12 October, instead of the current handovers at my door? That gives you an extra night with her, and the switch happens at school, which keeps things simple for her. Could you let me know by Wednesday 7 October? Thanks.
note: Leave the arguments out; the proposal solves them. If a handover ever feels unsafe, call emergency services.

situation: 离婚三年，儿子小树9岁，平时跟我住，隔周周末去他爸家。我和现在的丈夫要有宝宝了，预产期明年4月，我们打算10月10日周六一起告诉小树。想在那之前先跟前夫说一声，免得小树在他那边提起时他毫无准备，也想听听他对怎么跟孩子说有没有想法。
reply: 你好，有件事想在告诉小树之前先让你知道：我怀孕了，预产期明年4月。我们打算10月10日周六跟小树说。之后他到你那边可能会提起，或者有些情绪，你心里先有个准备。你对怎么跟他说有什么想法的话，10月8日周四前告诉我就行。谢谢。
note: 新家庭的消息先让对方父母知道：只讲和孩子有关的事实和日期，不谈感情细节，给对方一个提意见的期限。

situation: My daughter Hazel (9) splits the week between my place and her dad Simon's. Since September her winter coat and two school jumpers have gone to his and not come back, and on Tuesday she went to school without a coat. I want him to send them back in her bag at Sunday's handover, and I'll buy a second set of uniform so each house keeps its own.
reply: Hi Simon, a quick one about Hazel's things. Her winter coat and two school jumpers are at yours, and on Tuesday she went to school without a coat. Could you send them back in her bag at Sunday's handover? To stop things getting stuck at one house, I'll buy a second set of uniform so we each keep one. Does that work for you? Thanks.
note: Belongings without blame: where the things are, a fix that costs him nothing, and a yes-or-no question.

situation: Our daughter Ruby (12) has been having panic attacks before school since September, and her GP referred her to a child counsellor, Dr. Anita Shah, at the Elmwood Family Clinic. The first appointment is Tuesday 13 October at 4pm, then weekly on Tuesdays, and I can take her. The clinic needs consent from both parents by Friday 9 October, and my ex, Marcus, and I share decisions about her health.
reply: Hi Marcus, one thing about Ruby. She's been having panic attacks before school since September, and her GP has referred her to a child counsellor, Dr. Anita Shah, at the Elmwood Family Clinic. The first appointment is Tuesday 13 October at 4pm, then weekly on Tuesdays, and I can take her. The clinic needs consent from both of us by Friday 9 October. Could you let me know by Wednesday 7 October if you're okay to sign? Thanks.
note: A health decision goes in writing as facts plus one yes-or-no question, with no theories about the cause. If Ruby ever talks about hurting herself, contact emergency services or a crisis line straight away.

situation: Our son Theo turns 8 on Saturday 7 November, which is my ex Megan's weekend, and last year we each threw a separate party. I'd like to suggest one joint party from both of us at the Rollerdrome on Sunday 8 November, 2 to 4pm, £180 for 12 kids, split 50/50. I'm happy to book it and send the invites, and Theo would stay with Megan that weekend as planned.
reply: Hi Megan, about Theo's 8th birthday. Would you be open to one joint party this year, from both of us? There's a slot at the Rollerdrome on Sunday 8 November, 2 to 4pm, £180 for 12 kids, so £90 each. I'm happy to book it and send the invites, and he'd still be with you that weekend as planned. Could you let me know by Friday 16 October so I can hold the slot? Thanks.
note: A joint event is an offer, not something owed: propose it once with the cost and the work already sorted, and if she says no, plan your own celebration around her answer.

situation: 儿子果果6岁，我和前夫一人带一周，每周日下午3点交接。他上周六在我这吃了花生酱饼干后嘴唇肿了，今天医院确诊花生过敏，医生开了两支肾上腺素笔，要求随身带，照顾他的人都要会用。我想周日交接时给前夫一支，花5分钟教他用法，也希望他家里先别放含花生的零食。
reply: 你好，说一下果果的过敏。上周六他吃了花生酱饼干后嘴唇肿了，今天医院确诊是花生过敏。医生开了两支肾上腺素笔，要求随身带，照顾他的人都要会用。周日下午3点交接时我给你一支，花5分钟按医生教的给你演示一下用法。另外，你家里能不能先别放含花生的零食？周六前回我一下就行。谢谢。
note: 只写诊断和医嘱，不追究饼干是谁给的；一旦出现呼吸困难、嘴唇或喉咙肿胀，先用笔，马上打120。

situation: 离婚后女儿小米（12岁）一半时间住我这，一半住她爸家。小升初要在10月20日前填志愿，我倾向离我家近的实验中学，她爸倾向离他家近的十一中。实验中学开放日是10月10日周六上午，十一中是10月11日周日上午，我想我们俩都带小米去这两个开放日，听听她的想法，10月18日前一起定下来。
reply: 你好，说一下小米小升初填志愿的事，10月20日截止。两所学校都有开放日：实验中学是10月10日周六上午，十一中是10月11日周日上午。我想我们俩都带小米去这两个开放日，听听她自己的想法，然后在10月18日前一起定下来。你看可以吗？周三前回我一下就行。谢谢。
note: 两人意见不同时，先不在消息里争哪所学校好，只提一个一起了解、一起决定的流程，让孩子的想法有地方说。

situation: Mein Ex-Mann Jens fragt unseren Sohn Paul (8) nach jedem Wochenende bei mir aus, mit wem ich mich treffe, und schreibt mir dann Nachrichten wie „Wer war Samstag bei dir?“. Er kontrolliert mich schon seit der Trennung, und das macht mir Angst. Ich möchte nur auf die Übergabe am Samstag um 10 Uhr bei mir antworten und ihm einmal klar sagen, dass mein Privatleben kein Thema ist und Paul nicht ausgefragt werden soll.
reply: Hallo Jens, Samstag um 10 Uhr bei mir steht, Paul ist dann fertig. Fragen zu Paul beantworte ich gern, über mein Privatleben schreibe ich nicht. Bitte frag auch Paul nicht danach. Danke.
note: Nur die Logistik und eine klare Grenze, ohne Rechtfertigung; Nachrichten mit Datum sichern. Ständige Kontrolle kann Teil häuslicher Gewalt sein: Eine Beratungsstelle gegen häusliche Gewalt kann helfen, und bei akuter Gefahr den Notruf 110 wählen.

situation: 离婚一年，女儿彤彤（6岁）平时跟我住，隔周周末去她爸爸刘伟那里。彤彤奶奶直接给我发微信，说10月10日（周六）是她七十大寿，想让彤彤去吃饭，可那个周末轮到我。我愿意让彤彤去，周六上午10点我送过去、晚上8点我去接，但想跟刘伟本人把安排定下来，以后也不想跟奶奶来回商量。
reply: 你好，说一下10月10日（周六）的安排。你妈妈发微信跟我说那天是她七十大寿，想让彤彤去吃饭。那个周末本来轮到我，我同意彤彤去：周六上午10点我送过去，晚上8点我去接。送到哪里，麻烦你10月7日（周三）前告诉我。以后彤彤的时间安排，我们俩直接商量就好。谢谢。
note: 老人直接来问时，可以答应，但安排要落到孩子的爸爸身上；回奶奶一句“已经跟刘伟说好了”就够，不用解释更多。

situation: Our daughter Esme (13) splits the week between my place and her dad Neil's. We split her violin lessons 50/50, £180 a term, and this term is paid until the end of December. She's told both of us she wants to quit; I'd like her to finish the paid term and stop in January, and for Neil and me to tell her that together. I'd like his view by next Friday.
reply: Hi Neil, about Esme's violin. She's told us both she wants to stop. This term's lessons are paid until the end of December, so my suggestion is that she finishes the term and stops in January, and that we tell her together so she hears the same answer from both of us. Does that work for you, or do you see it differently? Could you let me know by next Friday? Thanks.
note: A joint decision about the child goes as one proposal and one question, so she isn't left negotiating with each house separately.

situation: 离婚判决书写的是儿子小宇（10岁）随前妻生活，我每隔一周的周末探望，寒暑假各接两周。前妻刚发微信说她工作调动，明年2月要带小宇搬去成都，让我“配合一下”。我不想吵，但搬走会改变判决书定的探望安排，想先说明现在还不能同意，约她10月10日周六或11日周日下午当面谈，同时自己先去咨询律师。
reply: 你好，谢谢你提前告诉我。搬到成都会改变判决书里定的探望安排，所以这件事我现在还不能答应。我想我们先当面谈一次，具体说说搬过去以后小宇的周末和寒暑假怎么安排，10月10日周六或11日周日下午我都可以，你看哪天方便？新的安排定下来之前，现在的探望照常。谢谢。
note: 涉及判决书的变更，先咨询律师或调解，按判决书和法院的程序走；消息里不争对错，只说清现在不同意和下一步。

situation: My ex-husband Dev's mother, Asha, died on Wednesday, and our kids, Priya (12) and Rohan (9), were close to her. The funeral is on Saturday 10 October, which is my weekend. I want to say I'm sorry and offer that the kids stay with him from Friday after school until Sunday at 6pm, or, if that's too much this week, I bring them to the service and take them home afterwards; I'd like his answer by Wednesday.
reply: Dev, I'm so sorry about your mum. Asha meant a lot to Priya and Rohan. The funeral is on Saturday 10 October, which is my weekend, so they're welcome to stay with you from Friday after school until Sunday at 6pm. If that's too much this week, I can bring them to the service and take them home afterwards instead. Which would you prefer? Could you let me know by Wednesday?
note: Condolences in one line, then the children's plan with two options, so he can choose what he can manage this week without negotiating.
